scope: Research-traceable factual records for all Lumbridge & Draynor, Morytania, and Varrock Achievement Diary tasks. This artifact records sourced requirements, boostability, item fate, determinism, fixed tier rewards, and canonical references only. It does not create diary actions, graph nodes or edges, account-state transitions, route recommendations, strategy scores, or inferred outcomes.

facts_included: consumed, reusable, optional, and state-bound item fate
completion determinism and explicit player-confirmation boundaries
fixed tier rewards and capability descriptions
verified behavior-level mappings to existing canonical records/actions

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a skill requirement unless the task explicitly says otherwise.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: A successful task action adds only its durable lumbridge_draynor_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not infer combat victory, catch/mine/theft success, farming growth, minigame score, cape ownership, quest completion, charged-item state, or daily uses.

verified_behavior_mappings.equivalence: Both require the unlocked Bones to Peaches spell, a qualifying cast in Al Kharid Palace, the standard spellbook, and the same 4 water, 4 earth, and 2 nature rune costs. The existing action owns the deterministic task milestone; this record does not add another action.

boundaries: Explorer's Ring tier representation and daily-use behavior remain owned by the existing Explorer's Ring fact/actions.
Mage Training Arena pizazz balances and Bones to Peaches acquisition remain owned by the existing unlock action and its linked facts.

Quest cape ownership, fairy-ring staff exemption, Slayer assignment, daily counters, catches, mines, thefts, combination-rune success, farming state, and minigame results remain observed or separately modeled.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Dorgesh-Kaan elite task
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: The current elite task is grappling a pylon on the Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course. Older guides that say to pickpocket Movario are stale; that task was replaced on 10 July 2024.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Former diary-gated shortcuts
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: Historical reward summaries list the Draynor narrow tunnel and Lumbridge swamp-to-desert grapple. Official Project Rebalance removed their achievement-diary requirements, so they are not current claim outputs in this package.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Bones to Peaches
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: The tablet does not complete the hard task. The spell purchase requires fixed pizazz thresholds, but collecting the points, supplying runes, and successful current unlock are not inferred from nominal access.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Quest cape elite task
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: Completion of all current quests, 65 Defence, a 99,000-coin cape purchase, ownership/equipment, and the emote are distinct conditions. A task model must never turn a quest prerequisite list into a completed Quest cape state.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Official source coverage
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: The current Wiki supplies live task and reward specifics. The official reward and shortcut posts are historical/change evidence only, not proof that unlisted current effects still apply.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Canifis Slayer Master wording

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Combat, Barrows, and Theatre of Blood
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: Nominal levels, gear, quest access, and Slayer levels never establish that the account can win a combat encounter, clear Barrows, own a complete Barrows set, or complete Theatre of Blood. Each diary combat task is player-confirmed; Theatre of Blood has no diary dependency here.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Farming and minigames
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: Harmony/Canifis crop growth, disease, yield, Temple Trek events, Trouble Brewing participation, and shade reward rolls require their own activity-state models and are not generated by task completion.

corrections_and_boundaries.subject: Ectofuntus and rewards
corrections_and_boundaries.detail: Ectofuntus XP/tokens, Robin daily availability, legs teleport counters, Bonecrusher charges, and Barrows rune quantity are concrete mechanics but variable/cooldown/charged state; claims expose capabilities rather than fabricate current counts.

records.claim_boundary: Tier claims remain player-confirmed diary_tiers observations. Lamps remain player-chosen entitlements. Daily purchases, charges, probability effects, crop state, and variable outcomes do not become automatic outputs.

corrections_and_boundaries.resolution: Older official release material describes easy/medium armour as coal/mithril. The live rewards page reports gold/lovakite respectively, and this package uses the current live values. Hard remains up to adamantite and elite covers any qualifying ore, with exceptions.

The old 2015 reward announcement said the Easy diary unlocked the furnace. The furnace is now generally accessible; the live diary reward is the armour's conditional double-bar chance at that furnace, so no furnace-access node is proposed.
Some Wiki reward text reports Grand Exchange resale profit. That is not a valid Ironman economic benefit and is deliberately excluded from the package's utility claims.
Existing production records already model Museum sources and exact counter changes. The 50- and 153-Kudos diary tasks reference that canonical counter rather than offer a second progression path.

The cape has a 66 Hunter equipment requirement, but Ironmen need 69 Hunter to personally catch dashing kebbits for the two required furs. Both facts are retained without assuming an acquisition method for non-Ironmen.

The source explicitly keeps the Medium task at 20 mahogany logs regardless of vouchers. For the Elite Lunar task, the current diary page says ten vouchers can halve the required plank, coin, and rune inputs; integration should source-check the precise spell transaction implementation before emitting state transitions.
The package does not auto-complete a fishing/mining action, Stronghold traversal, crop harvest, or potential range-bake burn. These require observed success or a dedicated simulation model.
